name: Sound on Plug
author: Bass57
description: Play a chill chime and track USB-storage presence when a drive is plugged in, unmounted, or unplugged. Fully user-space (udevadm monitor + UDisks2 via gdbus) — no root, no udev rules.

barWidget.description: Bar icon that is visible while any USB storage device is connected. Left click previews the plug sound, right the unplug sound, middle the unmount sound. Full plug / unmount / unplug monitoring requires the companion hook and systemd user service — run ./install.sh after cloning (see README).
